text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while heading back to the academy 
with Katsuragi Ace after an outing...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: Hey!! Thiefーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: What was that!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before her braced figure, a cat holding a 
package in its mouth dashed gallantly 
past. Weaving through the crowd, it 
vanished into a narrow alleyway.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Could the thief actually be a cat!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... That's right. The fish I 
just bought got snatched away...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"All right, leave it to me! I'm pretty 
sure it ran down that alley over there!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
You'll go for me...!? That alley is really 
narrow. There are empty crates and trash 
piled up, so watch your step!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll get that fish back for you!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's cramped as hell, sure... but! That 
don't mean squat to me!!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meowww...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "There you are! You're not getting away!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I finally caught up. Katsuragi Ace was 
sprinting across the stacked crates. Just 
then, the crates beneath her feet began to 
wobble—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw her leap. The next instant, startled 
by the case falling right before my eyes, 
my legs gave out completely.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"You know what you did wrong, right? Then 
don't do it again! Alright, off you go, 
off you go."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Well, that's pretty much how it 
goes... ......?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...? Hey! Trainer!? Don't tell me 
you're hurt—!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry!!
choice_data_list: Huh, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Because of my carelessness, I ended up 
putting Trainer in danger...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I got full of myself thinking I was 
fearless, and let it get to my head...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: If something were to happen to Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm just so anxious...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I was just scared...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Well, that sure makes it easy to 
give it my all...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's scary as hell, and nobody likes being 
scared. That's why you gotta use trial and 
error.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If she's afraid of the pack, we either 
train her to pass from the outside, or 
teach her how to weave safely through 
it...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Stacking up those efforts makes oneself 
even stronger... So that's how it works."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Words aren't going to get through 
here, no way.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer. I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm numb to fear.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you to point it out to 
me! Like when it's genuinely scary, or in 
dangerous situations!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I think if people point it out to me, 
eventually I'll be able to notice the fear 
on my own!
choice_data_list:
If I point it out, will you actually 
listen?
How did it feel to experience that fear?

Looks like it's gonna be a long road 
ahead!

ahead!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:

on my own!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but please speak up when you point 
things out.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
When I get all fired up, it's hard to hear 
anything going on around me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she's made up her mind, then I'll see 
this through with her to the very end. 
First up: practicing shouting at the top 
of our lungs.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I really don't want to experience that 
again... It felt absolutely terrible.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is what everyone's feeling 
all the time, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm truly humbled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was able to understand what it felt 
like for others to be terrified. That 
alone was a huge step forward for 
Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, why not! We're gonna be working 
together for a loooong time, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'm countin' on your advice from here 
on out too, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until the day she understands fear and 
gains even greater strength, I will stand 
by her side and support her.
